crossRefs.note: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands…
You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which Yahweh your God gives you, according to your tribes; and…
Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from…
The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came…
and bring these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand, and see how your brothers are doing, and bring back news.”
At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to…
I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

translations.web: The officers shall speak to the people, saying, “What man is there who has built a new house, and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.
translations.bsb: Furthermore, the officers are to address the army, saying, “Has any man built a new house and not dedicated it? Let him return home, or he may die in battle and another man dedicate it.
